Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses GENERAL TERMS AND TECHNICAL CONDITIONS Laboratory Information System (LIS/LIMS) – NABL / ISO 15189:2022 Support 1. Mandatory Compliance: The offered LIS/LIMS shall support applicable NABL requirements and releva nt ISO 15189:2022 information-management requirements. All functions specified below are mandatory. 2. Essential Functions: The system shall support patient registration, unique accession numbers, duplic ate checks, sample tracking/rejection, configurable test catalogues, manual result entry, automatic interfa cing with Erba XL 640 and H560 (subject to verified compatibility), correct patient/sample/result matching, detection of failed or unmatched transfers, retention of relevant flags, result review and authorization, con trolled PDF report generation, historical report retrieval, traceable report amendments preserving original reports, pending-work lists and nonconforming-work records. 3. Data Integrity and Cybersecurity: The system shall provide unique user accounts, role-based acces s, time-stamped audit trails, traceability of result entry/modifications/verification/authorization, protection against unauthorized alteration or deletion of audit records, confidentiality controls, defined data retention and export, backup and restoration, controlled configuration changes, and documented downtime, recover y and reconciliation procedures.

4. Validation and Documentation: The supplier shall provide product/version details, system requireme nts, available software validation evidence, user/administrator manuals and analyser-interface specificatio ns. The supplier shall support documented laboratory-led verification/validation and user acceptance testi ng before go-live, covering both analyser interfaces, result mapping, units, flags, patient/sample matching, authorization, report amendments, audit trails, access controls, backup restoration and downtime recover y. Test results, deviations and corrective actions shall be documented. 5. Training, Security and Support: Initial user and administrator training shall be included. The bidder shall declare the deployment model, hosting/data locations, vendor access, warranty/support period, respo nse arrangements and all recurring licence, hosting, messaging and AMC charges. Cloud/off-site hosting re quires purchaser approval. All mandatory functions, interfaces, implementation, training, applicable taxes and included support shall be covered by the quoted price, with no undisclosed charges. 6. Bidder Compliance and Experience: The bidder shall submit a requirement-wise compliance statem ent, disclose limitations/additional costs and demonstrate mandatory functions when requested. Preferenc e may be given, subject to applicable GeM/Government procurement rules, to bidders with verifiable LIS/LI MS implementation and support experience in Central/State Government medical laboratories or NABL-acc redited ISO 15189 medical laboratories. 7. Acceptance: Final acceptance and go-live shall be subject to satisfactory documented user acceptance testing and laboratory-led verification/validation. . 4.
